name: Mealie
tagline: Recipes, meal plans and shopping lists for the household.
description: Mealie keeps your recipes, imports new ones from a web page in one click, plans the week's meals and builds the shopping list, shared with everyone at home.
postInstall: Sign in with changeme@example.com and the password MyPassword, then change both at once in your profile.
Invite the rest of the household from Settings, Users, or set ALLOW_SIGNUP to true.

env.prompt: Let visitors create their own account (true or false)
